lines.explanation: Comments about the purpose and author of the program should be included in a program.  Multiline comments are surrounded by /* and */.
The preprocessor will interpret this line and insert system header file stdio.h right there
This line defines an integer array ndigs. This array has 10 elements from ndigs[0] fo ndigs [9]
It is a good habit to provide comments for main subparts of the program

This is a standard way to initialize an array. This fragment will set all 10 elements of the array  to zero. The loop will run exactly 10 times with i taking values from 0 to 9.  Notice that the first element of the array  is ndigs[0].
Another example of a comment for at the beginning of one of the  main subparts of the program
Read the next character until running out of characters to read (end of file = EOF).
Conditional statement in this if statement only accepts digits - symbols with code grater or equal '0' but less or equal '9'.  For any other value of c the condition will take the value 0 (false).

Here  the value of c is a code of a digit. The value of the array elements corresponding to this digit is incremented by one.  Every time a digit is found, the value in that array position increases by one, thus counting each digit that it reads in.  To g
This line prints the "arrow" on the vertical the axe..

This loop surrounds a smaller one.  Each time it repeats once, the inside loop completes a full cycle (many times). The inner loop is like a small gear that runs faster than a large one (the outer loop) it is connected to.
This line prints a part of the vertical  axe.
This loop runs completely each time a single loop is run in the outer loop.  It is nested within the larger loop.  Indentation makes it easier for human eyes to see where the inner block is.
As each loop is repeated, one star is printed.  Ultimately, this represents the value being counted, in a form of a bar chart. This makes it easy to compare values.

Each time the outer loop repeats once, a carriage return is added, so that the next row of stars in the inner loop appears on a new line each time. It waits until a complete cycle of the nested loop runs before creating a new line.
This line prints the horisontal axe.
End of main.  End of program.
